verdicts.reason: A breaks the product art. The cream circle has come loose and sits in the bottom-left corner touching the edge, and the can has lost its fill, so only an outline remains. The NEW badge floats alone in the top-right, away from the copy. B keeps the product art intact but crams everything into the top 40%, leaving the bottom 60% empty. Its Try It button is jammed against the right edge, almost touching the NEW badge and the headline. B is slightly less bad because the brand imagery survives.
